purpose: First approximate demand screen; detailed feasibility, competencies and actual product costs follow later

shared_assumptions.H_basis: Prior hypothetical D=30000, T=6, F=3000; not actual cost estimates for any niche
shared_assumptions.CPC_basis: Effective comparable cost, including actually nonrecoverable taxes where applicable; do not add a tax twice

price_hypothesis_bands.description: Специализированная функция с отдельно обоснованной высокой ценностью

price_band_policy: Record a rationale before evaluation. Not market prices or willingness-to-pay facts. Do not increase the price solely to rescue a failing candidate. Unknown payment mode/price requires clarification.

formulas.Q_min_guard: Undefined/infinite if contribution_per_click <= 0; do not divide or return a negative threshold
formulas.minimum_price_guard: Q>0 and a, CTR, CR, m > 0
formulas.rounding: Full precision for calculations; ceil final Q_min and displayed P_min in whole units
formulas.coverage_K: Q_low/Q_min_base(P_low) when the base threshold is finite

threshold_null_meaning: No positive contribution at this fixed price/scenario; not missing Wordstat data and not proof of absent demand

decision_rules.CLARIFY_DATA: A response exists but is incomplete, erroneous, not comparable, seasonal without a suitable time basis, or semantically ambiguous
decision_rules.REJECT_QUERY_IRRELEVANT: Documented non-target intent for this phrase; does not reject the whole topic
decision_rules.CLARIFY_PRICE: No justified price interval or unresolved subscription cash-flow model
decision_rules.PASS_TOPIC: Relevant usable data and justified price interval; finite Q_min_base(P_low); Q_low >= exact Q_min_base(P_low)
decision_rules.REJECT_TOPIC_VOLUME: Review of the declared cluster is complete, Q_high is justified, price interval justified; finite favorable threshold and Q_high < exact Q_min_favorable(P_high)
decision_rules.REJECT_REFERENCE_ECONOMICS: Same data/scope safeguards as topic rejection; no positive contribution even under favorable scenario at P_high; reason is scenario economics, NOT absent demand
decision_rules.CLARIFY_OTHER: All remaining cases, including passing only at the upper price or favorable acquisition assumptions
decision_rules.stress_role: Sensitivity label only; no independent rejection gate

Q_bounds_policy.unit: Relevant monthly search events for one declared task cluster, not unique people
Q_bounds_policy.exact: Q_low=Q_high=Q if a verified non-overlapping comparable total is available
Q_bounds_policy.unknown_overlap: For a finite measured set of fully relevant compatible sets, max(Q_i) <= union <= sum(Q_i); sum is only an upper bound
Q_bounds_policy.scope: Measured set bounds do not bound unseen synonyms or the whole market
Q_bounds_policy.null_vs_zero: Missing/error is null; zero only if explicitly returned successfully

deduplication.query_normalization: Trim outer whitespace only by default; preserve word order and all operators
deduplication.reuse_rule: Reuse complete compatible saved observations within the research wave; record retrieved_at and effective period
